shortDescription: Indonesia's annual inflation rate picked up to 3.19% in August from 2.88% the previous month, official data showed on Tuesday, to be roughly in line with the 3.13% expected by economists polled by Reuters.Statistics Indonesia will release core inflation and July trade data later on Tuesday.
